''See also: [[Anagi Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Anagi is a provincial ruler who holds the title of [[Archlord]] and serves as the [[Overlady]] of [[Sailfin Port]], overseeing its surrounding territories. Despite his status as a petty leader compared to the more prominent [[Monarch]] families, he possesses significant power and commands a group known as the [[Flashing Knives]]. He is proficient in combat, utilizing a sickle-and-chain weapon and accompanied by a winged dolphin. Anagi has demonstrated a defiant nature, challenging the Authority{{!}}authority of [[Sages]] and expressing confidence in his ability to confront them. He is also capable of manifesting black flames.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Anagi possesses a voice that is warm and slippery, much like a squirming eel. He has undergone three [[soulfire]] baptisms intended to perfect his physical form.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As a provincial ruler, Anagi exercises Authority{{!}}authority over those beneath him. He is currently focused on positioning his students for an invasion.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Anagi utilizes [[blue madra]] and possesses [[soulfire]], which can manifest as black flames. He fights with a chain-and-sickle weapon that has a blue shine and uses [[Ruler techniques]].}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Overlord of the province}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Anagi is a provincial ruler who exercises Authority{{!}}authority over his subordinates and serves as an Overlord, having held the rank of [[Archlord]] only a year prior.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c3">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 3</ref> To perfect his body, he has undergone three [[soulfire]] baptisms and currently utilizes [[blue madra]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c3" /> While positioning his students for an invasion, he speaks with a voice described as warm and slippery like a squirming eel.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c3" /> His combat abilities include [[Ruler techniques]] and the use of a chain-and-sickle weapon that possesses a blue shine and a [[binding]] filled with the fury of an ocean storm.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c3" /> Despite his power, Anagi has burst into black flames and currently finds himself wounded with depleted [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c3" />}}
